notes.title: [Free Game] [Release] FIRST STEAM GAME VHS - COLOR RETRO RACER : MILES CHALLENGE *Free on Steam Dec 29, 2017*
notes.notes:
FIRST STEAM GAME VHS - COLOR RETRO RACER : MILES CHALLENGE *Free Game on Steam Dec 29, 2017*

http://store.steampowered.com/app/768840/FIRST_STEAM_GAME_VHS__COLOR_RETRO_RACER__MILES_CHALLENGE/

http://steamcommunity.com/games/768840/announcements/detail/2783653064186260569

COLOR RETRO RACER: MILES CHALLENGE is the first steam game on VHS media.
Originally introduce in 1971 during the CES in Las Vegas, as a technological demonstration on the first videorecord

Your challenge is to run as many miles as possible in 3 different modes, enter your scores and set new records,
Hundreds of hours are waiting for you to become the best player in this very first VHS Steam game.
.

Please visit the store page for more info.
Thank you for all of your support.

OtakuMaker SARL
